note: Wabaunsee County zones (2023 Zoning Regulations; district boundary maps). The county's Zoning Maps page offers only a 2025 Zoning Map PDF. The county's ArcGIS service (WabaunseeCountyGIS, ATCiMaps) holds 911 layers only: address points, roads, municipal boundary, law/fire/EMS/ESZ. No zoning district polygon layer is queryable. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and Kansas GIS services found no Wabaunsee zoning service; the Regrid parcel dataset is commercial, not official.
